text:
jia: Hey all — planning to onboard comet-2.7b-quant to the model catalog tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need a deploy owner, someone to run smoke checks, and a rollback lead. Plan: canary 5% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> full if green. Will keep v1 pinned as immediate fallback. @sam @olivia any blockers?

sam: I can own the deploy. I’ll be around 09:15 PT to prep. Quick Q: what’s the quiet window and expected latency delta?

jia: Quiet window 09:30-10:00 PT. Perf team ran local perf — median token latency +12% for long-seq; should be fine. We have autoscale headroom.

olivia: I’ll run smoke (correctness + perf). Can you drop the smoke prompts and the curl snippet?

jia: Smoke prompts are the usual mix — long summary, instruction-following, and safety checks. Curl snippet:```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"comet-2.7b-quant","prompt":"Summarize the following in one sentence: <article>","max_tokens":50,"temperature":0.0}'
```

olivia: perfect. I’ll post results to the smoke doc: https://redwood.share/smoke/comet-2979 and add a pass/fail at 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:

mahi: I’ll be on infra watch and can flip the autoscale override if we see sustained queueing. I’ll also own the rollback hook. Rollback command in runbook: ```catalog pin --alias comet:stable --version comet-2.7b-v1``` — that swaps traffic back instantly.

lucas: Heads-up: if we need an emergency fallback before pin completes, we have the routing rule to divert read traffic to dedicated pool X (ops knows).

sam: Who will run the post-canary perf sampling? I can trigger the synthetic load if ops is OK.

mahi: Ops happy. Sam, please run the 5m synthetic at 09:50 PT and attach traces.

deploy-bot: [deploy-window] comet-2.7b-quant catalog-ingest scheduled by sam for 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z (09:30 PT) — canary 5% -> 50% -> full.

ops-bot: Reminder set: notify #eng-ml 5 minutes before deploy.

olivia: One more ask: can we keep canary traffic pinned to label "canary" so we can quickly query examples? If so I’ll collect a sample set.

jia: Yes, will create alias catalog/comet:canary and route 5% there. Also adding a metric alert: error-rate > 1.5% for 5m -> auto-rollback.

sam: Sounds good. I’ll start the PR to add the catalog entry and the rollout steps; will link it here when ready.

jia: Thanks team — plan: PR + runbook up by EOD today, deploy tomorrow 09:30 PT. Ping @channel 5m before. If anything blocks, drop it here. :rocket:
